title: Recharge Sync to Meter — SLA Monitoring

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_30min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at < '$to_date 00:00:00+05:30'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_60min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at < '$to_date 00:00:00+05:30'

SELECT date_trunc('hour', recharge_created_at) AS time, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_30min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "30-min SLA %", 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_60min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "60-min SLA %" FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at < '$to_date 00:00:00+05:30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT breach_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at < '$to_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND NOT sla_60min_met GROUP BY breach_reason ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: US SET CURRENT BALANCE AMOUNT: Success vs Failure

targets.rawSql: SELECT balance_cmd_status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at < '$to_date 00:00:00+05:30' GROUP BY balance_cmd_status

SELECT transaction_id, meter_number, account_id, amount, recharge_created_at, resolved_sync_ts, elapsed_seconds, breach_reason, balance_cmd_status FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at < '$to_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND NOT sla_60min_met ORDER BY elapsed_seconds DESC NULLS FIRST
